none: PAS ESS-A0D988: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy radiate of Claudius Gothicus AD 268 - AD 270 (Reece Period 13). Possible contemporary copy. The obverse shows a radiate bust facing right with the legend [IMP] C CLAVD[IVS AVG]. The reverse shows an altar with the legend [CONSECR]ATIO. Both the obverse and the reverse are off-flan. Mint not known. Die axis: 6 o'clock. Diameter: 20.05mm. Thickness: 0.90mm. Weight: 1.70g
